body: P2. user_library mutations invalidate request-local filters but never persistent MagicShelfCache. magic_shelf.py:962 trusts cached IDs and hydration lacks current membership intersection. Two independent real SQLite/rule probes warm [1,2], remove1 through actual remove_book, new request still returns[1,2]; bypass_cache returns[2]. Classic smart shelves use this helper. Scope mode switches/add/removal and user-filter changes when repairing invalidation. Do not claim Kobo retains removed books: its separate membership intersection at kobo.py:1662 protects removal.
